bounds: SentenceBoundary
Reg CF investment limits depend on whether you are an accredited investor and, for non-accredited investors, on annual income and net worth.
SentenceBoundary
If either measure is below $124,000, the 12-month limit is the greater of $2,500 or 5% of the greater measure.
SentenceBoundary
If both are at least $124,000, it is 10% of the greater measure.
SentenceBoundary
Under either formula, the aggregate cap is $124,000 across all Reg CF offerings in any rolling 12 months.
SentenceBoundary
For example, with income of $50,000 and net worth of $40,000, 5% of the greater figure is $2,500, so the limit is $2,500.
SentenceBoundary
With income of $150,000 and net worth of $80,000, 5% of $150,000 is $7,500.
SentenceBoundary
Track commitments across portals, not one app.
SentenceBoundary
Net-worth rules exclude your primary residence and treat some related debt specially.
SentenceBoundary
Accredited investors are not subject to Reg CF investment limits.
SentenceBoundary
Verify current rules and how the intermediary calculates your limit before investing.
